title.zh: ChatGPT Work 上线全量重置已启动

body.zh: Tibo 宣布已启动 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 的全量用量重置，预计在接下来一小时内推送。
body.en: Tibo said the full ChatGPT Work and Codex quota reset had been triggered and was expected to propagate over the next hour.

title.zh: 上线后第一次额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 宣布已重置 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的用量额度，并预告当天稍后还有第二次。
body.en: Tibo announced that Codex and ChatGPT Work usage limits had been reset, with a second reset to follow later that day.

title.zh: 上线后第二次额度重置

body.zh: Tibo 宣布当天第二次重置适用于所有 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 用户，预计在 30 分钟内推送。
body.en: Tibo announced the second reset of the day for all ChatGPT Work and Codex users, expected to roll out within 30 minutes.

appliesTo.zh: 所有 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 用户
appliesTo.en: All ChatGPT Work and Codex users

title.zh: 重置失败补发预存重置券
title.en: Banked resets reissued after redemption failures

body.zh: Tibo 确认向受影响两小时内点过重置按钮的约 50 万名 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 用户补发一次预存重置。
body.en: Tibo confirmed a replacement banked reset for about 500,000 Codex and ChatGPT Work users who had clicked reset during the affected two-hour window.

appliesTo.zh: 受影响时间内点过重置的用户
appliesTo.en: Users who clicked reset in the affected window

title.zh: 700 万活跃用户预存重置券已发放
title.en: 7 million user milestone banked reset granted

body.zh: Tibo 宣布已给所有 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 用户发放一次预存重置，可在桌面或网页兑换，补满周额度。
body.en: Tibo announced a banked reset for all Codex and ChatGPT Work users. Redeeming it on desktop or web replenished weekly usage.

appliesTo.zh: 所有 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 用户
appliesTo.en: All Codex and ChatGPT Work users

title.zh: 800 万活跃用户庆祝重置

body.zh: Tibo 宣布正在为所有 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 用户再次重置用量额度。

appliesTo.zh: 所有 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 用户
appliesTo.en: All Codex and ChatGPT Work users

title.zh: 900 万活跃用户庆祝重置

body.zh: Tibo 宣布为 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 用户再次重置周额度，预计几分钟内恢复。
body.en: Tibo announced another weekly quota reset for Codex and ChatGPT Work users, expected to reach them in a few minutes.

appliesTo.en: Codex and ChatGPT Work users

body.zh: Tibo 宣布已为所有 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 用户重置额度，并介绍了 Sol 的用量效率改进。
body.en: Tibo announced a usage reset for all ChatGPT Work and Codex users alongside Sol efficiency improvements.

title.zh: 周一追加额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 确认完成了此前承诺的周一追加额度重置。
body.en: Tibo confirmed completion of the additional Monday reset that he had previously announced.

title.zh: 1,500 万活跃用户庆祝重置

body.zh: Tibo 宣布突破 1,500 万活跃用户后将提供一次重置，预计约一小时内推送。
body.en: Tibo announced a reset after reaching 15 million active users and expected it to roll out in about an hour.

title.zh: 2,000 万活跃用户庆祝重置券

body.zh: Tibo 宣布当天将为每位 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 用户发放一次可自行使用的预存重置。
body.en: Tibo announced a banked reset for every Codex and ChatGPT Work user that day, redeemable at a time of their choice.

appliesTo.zh: 所有 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 用户
appliesTo.en: All Codex and ChatGPT Work users

title.zh: 用量问题修复后的重置已推送

body.zh: Tibo 引用此前的付费订阅重置计划，确认重置已推送至账户，同时落实了用量修复。
body.en: Quoting the prior reset plan for paid subscriptions, Tibo confirmed the reset had propagated to accounts alongside usage fixes.

appliesTo.zh: 所有付费订阅
appliesTo.en: All paid subscriptions

title.en: Paid quota reset after usage fixes

body.zh: Tibo 宣布正在为所有付费 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 用户重置用量。随后，他在回复中给出了预计推送时间。
body.en: Tibo announced that usage was being reset for all paid Codex and ChatGPT Work users. He gave the expected rollout time in a follow-up reply.

appliesTo.zh: 所有付费 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 用户
appliesTo.en: All paid Codex and ChatGPT Work users

title.zh: 2,500 万活跃用户庆祝重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 宣布为所有付费 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 订阅重置用量额度，庆祝达到 2,500 万活跃用户。
body.en: Tibo announced that usage had been reset for all paid ChatGPT Work and Codex subscriptions to celebrate reaching 25 million active users.

appliesTo.zh: 所有付费 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 订阅
appliesTo.en: All paid ChatGPT Work and Codex subscriptions

title.zh: Astra 访问补偿重置券计划
title.en: Banked reset plan for delayed Astra access

body.zh: Tibo 宣布从当天起，付费 ChatGPT 用户每有一天无法使用 Astra，就可获得一次预存重置。首批预计约三小时后发放。
body.en: Tibo announced one banked reset for each day a paid ChatGPT user lacked access to Astra, starting that day. The first grant was expected in about three hours.

appliesTo.zh: 当时无法使用 Astra 的付费 ChatGPT 用户
appliesTo.en: Paid ChatGPT users without Astra access at the time

title.zh: Astra 上线重置券已按计划到期标记完成
title.en: Astra launch banked reset marked complete after EOD

body.zh: 已按 EOD 计划到期自动标记完成。Tibo 宣布为 Plus、Pro 和 Business 用户发放预存重置券，并包含太平洋时间当晚 8 点前创建账户或升级的用户。个人实际到账时间以账户为准。
body.en: Automatically marked complete after the estimated EOD deadline. Tibo announced a banked reset for Plus, Pro and Business, including eligible users who created or upgraded an account before 8 p.m. Pacific. Individual receipt times may vary.

appliesTo.zh: Plus、Pro 和 Business 用户
appliesTo.en: Plus, Pro and Business users

title.zh: Astra 付费订阅额度重置已完成
title.en: Paid subscription reset for Astra complete

body.zh: Tibo 引用面向所有付费订阅的全球额度重置计划，确认重置完成。
body.en: Quoting the global reset plan for all paid subscriptions, Tibo confirmed it was complete.

appliesTo.zh: 所有付费订阅
appliesTo.en: All paid subscriptions

title.zh: Astra 额度重置已推送

body.zh: Tibo 引用了面向 Astra 用户的质量更新及重置计划，确认重置已全部推送。
body.en: Quoting the Astra quality update and reset plan, Tibo confirmed that the reset had fully propagated.

appliesTo.zh: Astra 用户
appliesTo.en: Astra users

title.zh: Sol 与 Luna 上线预存重置券
title.en: Banked reset for the Sol and Luna launch

body.zh: Tibo 宣布正在为 Plus、Pro 和 Business 账户发放一次预存重置。
body.en: Tibo announced that one banked reset was being added to Plus, Pro and Business accounts.

appliesTo.zh: Plus、Pro 和 Business 用户
appliesTo.en: Plus, Pro and Business users

title.zh: 额度重置已全部推送

body.zh: Tibo 确认重置已全部推送。
body.en: Tibo confirmed that the resets had fully propagated.

title.zh: 全球额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 已宣布全球额度重置完成。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Tibo has announced that the global quota reset is complete. Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

appliesTo.zh: 所有付费 ChatGPT 账户
appliesTo.en: All paid ChatGPT accounts

title.zh: 额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 已宣布本次额度重置处理完成。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Tibo has announced that the reset has been processed. Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

title.zh: 可留存重置已发放

body.zh: Tibo 已确认，第 3 天赠送的一次可留存重置已发放至所有付费账户。可查看当前账号的可用重置次数；这次发放不等于立即重置正在使用的额度。
body.en: Tibo has confirmed that the Day 3 banked reset has landed across all paid accounts. Check your account’s available resets; this grant does not immediately reset the quota currently in use.

appliesTo.zh: 所有付费账户
appliesTo.en: All paid accounts

title.zh: 全球额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 引用第 6 天的全球额度重置计划，确认本次重置已全部生效。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Tibo quoted the Day 6 global quota reset plan and confirmed that the reset has fully propagated. Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

title.zh: 全球额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 引用第 8 天的全球额度重置计划，确认本次重置已完成。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Tibo quoted the Day 8 global quota reset plan and confirmed that the reset is complete. Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

title.zh: 第 10 天额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 引用第 10 天的额度重置计划，确认本次重置已完成。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Tibo quoted the Day 10 quota reset plan and confirmed that the reset is complete. Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

title.zh: 第 13 天额度重置已完成

body.zh: 第 13 天额度重置已完成。Tibo 随后发布“Done”；原 EOD 计划已过期，不再显示待确认。完成公告时间不代表各账号实际到账时刻。
body.en: The Day 13 quota reset is complete. Tibo subsequently posted “Done”; the original EOD deadline has passed, so the event is no longer pending confirmation. The announcement time is not each account’s actual reset time.

title.zh: 第 15 天额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 引用先前的第 15 天节目帖，宣布已进行额度重置：“and reset. Enjoy.”。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Quoting his earlier Day 15 broadcast post, Tibo announced a quota reset: “and reset. Enjoy.” Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

title.zh: 受影响账号将获 credits 补偿

body.zh: Tibo 确认约 4 万个账号的用量扣算与实际所选套餐不一致，问题已修复，团队正在逐一联系受影响用户，并承诺向受影响账号补发 credits；原帖未说明金额或到账时间。
body.en: Tibo identified about 40,000 accounts whose applied usage limits did not match their selected plan. The issue is corrected, affected users are being contacted individually, and credits will be added to affected accounts. No amount or delivery time was specified.

title.zh: 第17天额度重置计划

body.zh: Tibo 宣布第17天将进行额度重置，并在相关回复中说明“明天 PST 上午10点前到账”。目前按计划记录，尚无完成确认；原帖未明确适用范围。
body.en: Tibo announced a Day 17 quota reset and added in a related reply: “Lands tomorrow before 10am PST.” Recorded as planned, with no completion confirmation or explicit eligibility scope.

title.zh: 第18天额度重置计划

body.zh: Tibo 宣布第18天再次进行额度重置，并在相关回复中说明将于“明天 PST 上午10点前”与一项小更新一起落地。目前按计划记录，尚无完成确认或明确适用范围。
body.en: Tibo announced another quota reset for Day 18. A related reply says it will land tomorrow before 10am PST alongside a small update. Recorded as planned; completion and eligibility scope were not specified.

title.zh: 第20天额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 引用第20天重置截止回复，宣布已全部传播完成。公告不代表每个账号的实际到账时刻，原文未明确适用范围。
body.en: Quoting the Day 20 reset deadline reply, Tibo announced that it has all propagated. This announcement does not establish each account’s actual arrival time; eligibility scope was not specified.

title.zh: 第21天重置已按计划到期完成
title.en: Day 21 reset marked complete after EOD

body.zh: 已按 EOD 计划到期自动标记完成。依据 Tibo“今天重置”的计划，美西10月25日的估算截止已过；这不是官方完成确认，也不代表每个账号的实际到账时刻。
body.en: Automatically marked complete after the estimated EOD deadline. The estimated end of October 25 in Los Angeles has passed for Tibo’s “today” reset plan. This is not official completion confirmation or each account’s actual arrival time.

title.zh: 第23天额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 引用第23天重置截止回复，宣布“已完成”。公告不代表每个账号的实际到账时刻，原文未明确适用范围。
body.en: Quoting the Day 23 reset deadline reply, Tibo announced that it is done. This announcement does not establish each account’s actual arrival time; eligibility scope was not specified.

title.zh: 第27天可储存重置 1/2

body.zh: Tibo 在第26天预告未来两天将提供可储存重置，随后公布“Banked 1/2”。原文未说明适用范围、使用方法或到期规则，公告不代表每个账号的实际到账时刻。
body.en: Following the Day 26 plan for two days of banked resets, Tibo announced “Banked 1/2”. Eligibility, redemption and expiry rules were not specified. The announcement does not establish each account’s actual arrival time.

title.zh: 第28天可储存重置 2/2

body.zh: Tibo 公布“Day 28/ Banked 2/2”，接续第26天预告的两天可储存重置计划。原文未说明适用范围、使用方法或到期规则，公告不代表每个账号的实际到账时刻。
body.en: Tibo announced “Day 28/ Banked 2/2”, following the Day 26 plan for two days of banked resets. Eligibility, redemption and expiry rules were not specified. The announcement does not establish each account’s actual arrival time.

title.zh: 预存重置券已激活

body.zh: Tibo 宣布预存重置券已激活，预计随后陆续入账。
body.en: Tibo said the banked reset had been activated and should reach accounts soon.

title.zh: ChatGPT Business 团队获赠预存重置
title.en: Banked reset for ChatGPT Business teams

body.zh: Tibo 宣布向 ChatGPT Business 团队赠送一次可自行兑换的预存重置。具体到账情况以团队账户为准。
body.en: Tibo announced one banked reset for ChatGPT Business teams to redeem when they choose. Check your team account for availability.

appliesTo.zh: ChatGPT Business 团队
appliesTo.en: ChatGPT Business teams
